title: Public Relations and Media Skills
overview: Public Relations (PR) professionals must consistently work to present a positive image of their organization while being prepared to respond swiftly to any crisis that may arise. By investing effort in building a solid reputation during favorable times, businesses can better withstand negative press during challenging situations. This course will equip participants with a clear understanding of their roles as PR professionals, enhance their verbal and written communication skills, and provide them with the ability to evaluate crisis situations and effectively engage with the media to promote the organization’s reputation.
audience: This course is aimed at public relations officers and other key personnel who engage with both internal and external audiences, particularly managers and supervisors in personnel, marketing, sales, training, and administration.
methodology: The course is designed to be interactive and participatory, utilizing various learning tools to help participants function effectively and efficiently. Learning methods include presentations by the trainer, group exercises, roundtable discussions, video clips, case studies, and debriefing sessions.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Analyze and assess contemporary PR concepts and strategies in various contexts
Appropriately evaluate PR techniques and approaches to connect them with their working environment
Demonstrate essential PR skills in verbal and written communication, as well as editorial, layout, and production techniques
Apply key media skills relevant to PR
Prepare and deliver effective oral messages in public settings
Leverage their PR skills as effective promotional tools
